subject: general
question:
**Convert the sentence provided below from its passive voice structure to an active voice structure:**

The decision was expected to be made by the council after further review.

options.text: The council expected making a decision after review.
It was expected that the council would make the decision after review.
The council made the decision as was expected.
The council was expected to have made the decision.

solution:
The correct answer is '2' i.e. It was expected that the council would make the decision after review .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is written in passive voice: *"The decision was expected to be made by the council after further review."*
 
• To convert this into the active voice, the subject of the sentence (the council) becomes the doer of the action.
 
• The correct active voice structure would be: *"It was expected that the council would make the decision after review."*
 
• Option 2 accurately reflects this conversion and maintains the intended meaning of the original sentence.
 
• Other options fail due to inaccuracies in grammar or meaning:
 
 
• **Option 1:** *"The council expected making a decision after review."* – Incorrect grammar; "expected making" is not standard usage.
 
• **Option 3:** *"The council made the decision as was expected."* – Changes the tense and meaning of the original sentence.
 
• **Option 4:** *"The council was expected to have made the decision."* – Alters the tense and context of the original sentence.
 

Correct sentence: *It was expected that the council would make the decision after review*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Active vs. Passive Voice:**
 
 
• In the passive voice, the subject receives the action (e.g., "The decision was expected to be made").
 
• In the active voice, the subject performs the action (e.g., "It was expected that the council would make the decision").
 
 
 
• **Maintaining Meaning:**
 
 
• When converting from passive to active voice, ensure the meaning and tense of the original sentence remain intact.
 
 

5b:T
